items.summary: Create backend admin authentication system in main.mo with stable variable for storing admin credentials (username and hashed password), and actor methods for admin login verification that returns a session token or admin principal identifier upon successful authentication

Implement role-based access control in backend by adding admin role type to user profile data structure and creating guard methods that verify admin status before allowing access to admin-only operations

Create AdminLogin.tsx page component with form containing username and password input fields, login button, form validation, and error message display that authenticates against the backend admin authentication system

Implement frontend admin session management using React Context or local storage to persist admin authentication state, storing admin session token or identifier after successful login and clearing it on logout

Create protected route wrapper component for admin routes that checks admin authentication status and redirects unauthenticated users to the admin login page before allowing access to admin dashboard and admin management pages
Update AdminPanel.tsx to display admin profile information (logged-in username, role) in the header section and add logout button that clears admin session and redirects to admin login page
Add admin login route to App.tsx routing configuration at path /admin/login that renders the AdminLogin component and is accessible without authentication
